name: Mita Yorimasa
source:
A very normal boy. (With somewhat abnormal tastes.)

He just wants a cute girl to have a lovey-dovey, lewd, and happy relationship with, as is the desire of most boys his age.

But his tastes are very specific-- he only likes fat girls. Convinced he'd never find his ideal lover, Yorimasa thought he'd be lonely for his entire life.

Although normally a very earnest person, sometimes his desires get the better of him, and he does unreasonable things. He's also a bit tough to reach in terms of emotional matters, he doesn't seem to notice when he's hurt someone's feelings and he misunderstands the situation sometimes.
